outputs.description: List of output configurations (required for any of= directive usage). Each item defines a target output file or pipe command with optional split/diffwr settings. Note: split= and splitformat= must appear *before* the of= directive in the command line, so they are attached per-output item but ordering in generated config depends on YAML/JSON order semantics.

block_size.description: Block size (ibs=obs=) in bytes. Default: 32768 (32 KiB)

input_block_size.description: Input block size in bytes (ibs=). Overrides block_size if set.

output_block_size.description: Output block size in bytes (obs=). Overrides block_size if set.

conv.description: List of conversion keywords (e.g., ["noerror", "sync", "ascii"]). Valid values: ascii, ebcdic, ibm, block, unblock, lcase, notrunc, ucase, swab, noerror, sync.

count_blocks.description: Number of input blocks to copy (count=)

limit_bytes.description: Number of bytes to copy (limit=). Alternative to count=.

skip_blocks.description: Number of input blocks to skip (skip=)

seek_blocks.description: Number of output blocks to skip (seek=)

hash_algorithms.description: List of hash algorithms to compute in parallel (hash=). Supported: md5, sha1, sha256, sha384, sha512

hash_window_bytes.description: Hash window size in bytes (hashwindow=). If zero, disabled.

status.description: Whether to show continual status output (status=)

sizeprobe_mode.description: Size probing method (sizeprobe=). Valid: "if", "of", or a numeric BYTES value

md5_file.description: MD5 hash log file (md5log=). Deprecated; use outputs[].hash_log_file["md5"] instead.

sha1_file.description: SHA1 hash log file (sha1log=). Deprecated; use outputs[].hash_log_file["sha1"] instead.

sha256_file.description: SHA256 hash log file (sha256log=). Deprecated; use outputs[].hash_log_file["sha256"] instead.

sha384_file.description: SHA384 hash log file (sha384log=). Deprecated; use outputs[].hash_log_file["sha384"] instead.

sha512_file.description: SHA512 hash log file (sha512log=). Deprecated; use outputs[].hash_log_file["sha512"] instead.
